# LeadFinder Pro

> LeadFinder helps freelancers and agencies find local businesses without websites and turn them into web design clients via WhatsApp and SMS outreach.

LeadFinder Pro is a lead generation tool that searches Google for local businesses, identifies those without websites, and provides a built-in CRM to track outreach via WhatsApp, SMS, and calls. It includes message templates, pipeline tracking, and a 5-day free trial.

## Pages

- [Home / Landing](/landing): Product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Get Started](/start): Account creation and subscription details.
- [Start Free Trial](/start-free-trial): Begin a 5-day free trial.
- [Sign In / Sign Up](/auth): Authentication for existing or new users.
- [How To Use Guide](/guide): Step-by-step guide for finding and contacting clients.
- [Partner Program](/partners): Affiliate program for referring new users.
- [Feedback](/feedback): Send product feedback to the team.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms and conditions.
